DeviceTrial.title: DeviceTrial
DeviceTrial.description: Device-bound 7-day free trial anchor preventing repeat trials across reinstalls, data clears, or account switches on the same physical device.

deviceHash.description: 64-char SHA-256 hex digest identifying the physical Android device.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the first Google user who activated the trial on this device.

lastUserId.description: Most recent Firebase Auth UID observed using this device.

accountSwitchCount.description: Number of times a different Google account accessed this device record.

trialStartedAt.description: Immutable server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp) when this device first started its free trial.

lastVerifiedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp) written on sync to establish authoritative server time.

isPremiumDevice.description: Whether an active subscription has been verified on this device.

subscriptionExpiresAt.description: Timestamp when the current 30-day monthly subscription expires.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync.

UserEntitlement.title: UserEntitlement
UserEntitlement.description: Per-user subscription, trial, real-time preferences, and admin moderation record bound to Google Sign-In UID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in Google user.

phoneNumber.description: User phone number displayed in Profile and Admin directory.

deviceHash.description: Latest device SHA-256 fingerprint associated with this user.

trialStartedAt.description: Immutable server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp) of the user's first trial start.

isPremiumUser.description: Whether the user holds an active paid subscription.

subscriptionStatus.description: Real-time user subscription status synchronized with payment submissions and admin approvals.

subscriptionProductId.description: Subscription product or UPI plan identifier.

purchaseToken.description: Latest verified Play Billing purchase token or approved UPI transaction reference.

subscriptionExpiresAt.description: Timestamp when the user's current 30-day monthly subscription expires.

isBlocked.description: Admin-controlled flag that suspends access for this user.

bonusTrialDays.description: Extra trial days granted to this user by the admin.

adminNote.description: Optional admin note attached to this user account.

hideSubscriptionUI.description: Admin toggle to instantly hide or show subscription cards and payment status UI for this user.

autoCallRecording.description: User preference for automatic call recording synced in real time across sessions.

themeMode.description: User display theme preference synced in real time across sessions.

dialpadTonesEnabled.description: User preference for keypad tones and haptics synced in real time across sessions.

blockedNumbers.description: User's blocked phone numbers list synced in real time across sessions.

quickDeclineResponses.description: User's quick decline SMS templates synced in real time across sessions.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the user record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user record was updated.

PaymentRequest.title: PaymentRequest
PaymentRequest.description: UPI subscription payment submission verified from UPI app response or UTR and queued for admin approval or disapproval.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the submitting user.

userName.description: Display name of the submitting user.

userEmail.description: Google email of the submitting user.

deviceHash.description: 64-char SHA-256 device hash for which access is requested.

upiId.description: Recipient UPI VPA configured for payments (default elx@ptaxis).

upiTxnId.description: UPI gateway transaction ID or 12-digit UTR number.

approvalRefNo.description: Bank approval reference number returned by the UPI app.

upiResponseStatus.description: Automatic UPI verification status or manual UTR submission indicator.

reviewedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who reviewed the payment.

reviewNote.description: Optional note entered by the admin during review.

AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Admin-managed global app settings controlling trial duration, pricing, UPI payee, support WhatsApp number, feature flags, and maintenance mode.

trialDays.description: Default number of free trial days per device (1-365, default 7).

whatsappNumber.description: WhatsApp support phone number without country prefix or digits-only (default 9012634797).

enforceSingleDeviceTrial.description: Whether device-bound anti-abuse trial enforcement is active.

allowCallRecording.description: Global toggle enabling or disabling call recording.

allowManualUtr.description: Whether users can submit manual 12-digit UTR references.

maintenanceMode.description: When true, non-admin app tabs are temporarily locked with maintenanceMessage.

maintenanceMessage.description: Message shown to users when maintenanceMode is enabled.

announcementText.description: Optional broadcast banner shown on the user Account screen.

dialpadTonesDefault.description: Global default for dialpad keypad tones and haptics pushed to connected clients.

defaultAutoRecording.description: Global auto call recording setting pushed to all authorized active devices.

forceThemeMode.description: Theme enforcement mode pushed to all devices (user, light, or dark).

hideSubscriptionUI.description: Global toggle making subscription cards and payment status UI disappear or appear in real-time.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who updated the settings.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp) when settings were saved.

NavigationTabsConfig.title: NavigationTabsConfig
NavigationTabsConfig.description: Server-driven BottomNavigationView tabs pushed in real-time via app_config/navigation_tabs.

tabs.description: Ordered list of built-in or custom bottom navigation tab objects.

SettingsItemsConfig.title: SettingsItemsConfig
SettingsItemsConfig.description: Server-driven dynamic settings list pushed in real-time via app_config/settings_items.

items.description: Ordered list of setting toggles and action rows.

LiveBroadcast.title: LiveBroadcast
LiveBroadcast.description: Instant live modal popup and custom banner ad broadcast document (app_config/live_broadcast).

/device_trials/{deviceHash}.description: Device-level trial registry enforcing one 7-day free trial per physical device.

/users/{userId}.description: Authenticated user entitlement, real-time user preferences, subscription status, and admin user management controls.

/payment_requests/{requestId}.description: UPI payment verification requests awaiting admin approval or disapproval to manage full access.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Admin-managed global app configuration documents (global_settings, navigation_tabs, settings_items, live_broadcast).
